dashboard.label: ITSI Setup
dashboard.description: Install IT Essentials Work / ITSI (app 5403, v5.0.x) in three steps.

div.div: IT Essentials Work (ITE-W) and ITSI are the same app (Splunkbase 5403). No license → runs free as ITE-W. Add an ITSI license → full ITSI. Use v5.0.x for this box (Splunk 10.4).

search.query: | rest /services/apps/local | search title="itsi" OR title="SA-ITOA" OR title="SA-ITSI-*" OR title="DA-ITSI-*" | eval Version=if(version="" OR isnull(version),"—",version) | rename title as App, label as Name | table App Name Version | sort App
| rest /services/licenser/licenses | eval GB=round(quota/1024/1024/1024,1) | rename label as License, type as Type | table License Type GB | sort - GB

div.p: Just skip it → run free ITE-W (services, KPIs, Service Analyzer). Zero risk.
⚠ In a Splunk demo org this box is a license peer — its license comes from a central manager, so a local .lic is ignored and switching to a local manager breaks the platform. Don't do that.

Need full ITSI? Have the ITSI license added on the central license manager — this peer then inherits it automatically. Check the Licenses loaded panel above; if an ITSI row is already there, you're done.
Host the 5.0.1 .spl at a URL, then run apply.sh — it extracts it into etc/apps, installs Java, and restarts:
Entitled account? Use SPLUNKBASE_APP_IDS="5403" instead. (ITSI_LICENSE_URL only applies to a standalone instance — ignored on a demo-org license peer.)
Step 2 restarts for you. Then refresh this page — the tiles above should show installed — and open the app:
Didn't restart? Run: sudo -u splunk /opt/splunk/bin/splunk restart

html.p: Get the package: Splunkbase app 5403, version 5.0.x (supports Splunk 10.2–10.5). • Install method: extract the .spl into etc/apps only — never Splunk Web upload or splunk install app. • Survives reset: both env vars re-apply on every session boot. • No license? It runs as free ITE-W and the interim Service Health dashboard is the lighter demo.
